stem: The angle ${=fixed(x, 4)}^\circ$ is written in the form $d^\circ\, m'\, s''$ with $m$ and $s$ whole numbers. Find the value of $s$.
solution: The whole degrees are ${=d}$. The decimal part is ${=fixed(x, 4)} - {=d} = {=fixed(x - d, 4)}^\circ$
Multiply by 60 to get minutes: ${=fixed(x - d, 4)} \times 60 = {=fixed(mins, 2)}'$, so $m = {=mw}$
The decimal part of the minutes is ${=fixed(mins - mw, 2)}'$. Multiply by 60 to get seconds: ${=fixed(mins - mw, 2)} \times 60 = {=s}''$
notes: Reverse conversion; values chosen so decimals terminate exactly (4 d.p. exact). Asks only for s to keep a single numeric answer; the method needs both steps.
